summary: Kora OS ERP sprints A/B/C/D validated end-to-end. 18/20 pytest tests pass (2 skipped only because the demo tenant's single confirmed event has zero reserved inventory items). Frontend flows for Packing List, Check-in dialog, Damaged Items Log, and Inventory cost visibility all render correctly with expected data-testids and match the requested behavior.

minor.issue: Existing damaged_items_log entry from DN-0002 has empty inventory_item_id and item_name (log_id=dlog_5df86aeb37ac). The endpoint accepts an item without a valid inventory_item_id and logs it with '' fields + replacement_cost=0. Consider adding server-side validation to reject/normalize items missing inventory_item_id, or fall back to the note's item-name for readability in the log.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised end-to-end via the UI in this tenant because the only confirmed event ('Lanzamiento Q1 - Marketing Interno' on 4/15/2026) has ZERO reserved inventory items. The endpoint works (GET /packing-list-live returns total_items=0), but the 'Generar Conduce de Salida' button never becomes reachable in this tenant. Suggest seeding at least one reserved item on the demo tenant's confirmed event to make the happy path demoable.

The route /ops-supplies/event-packing renders correctly, but the 'Packing List' tab is NOT visible in the Resource Management top-tabs bar for this demo tenant. Visible tabs are: tab-inventory, tab-purchasing, tab-asset-count, tab-agreements, tab-maintenance only. Main agent noted the tab is gated by industries=['events','events_hospitality','generic'] — verify the demo tenant's industry field actually includes one of those values, or loosen the gating.

Feature is implemented correctly (verified in code /app/frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.js:700-711 with data-testid=`no-cost-${ing.ingredient_id}`). Could NOT be validated on live UI because every ingredient in the demo tenant already has cost_per_unit > 0 (Aceite $0.51/ml, Chicken $8.50/kg, Olive Oil $12/l, Sal Marina $85/unit, Salt $1.50/kg, Test $5/unit, Tomatoes $2.50/kg). Suggest seeding a zero-cost ingredient to demo the warning.
